Name: Build Mode For Tiles and Big Craftables (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

Design your base faster by allowing you to select large areas to add or remove floor tiles and craftables like kegs.
In [b]build mode[/b], your able to navigate camera across the area to start adding or remove flooring tiles, gates, fences, kegs, etc by using your mouse to select area to add floor tiles or remove selected area floor tiles/craftables.


[b]Watch Video[/b] 
V1.0.5 Changes: 
Note: Used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7363]Zoom Level [/url]Mod to zoom in and out in video as it pairs well with my mod.

Original Release

[b]Hotkeys[/b]
F1 - Go into build mode,  
Left click - drag and click to select a highlighted area to confirm to remove tiles or place selected inventory item in area.  Right click  during selection to cancel.
Space- to toggle between placing tiles or removing them.

[b]Requires[/b]
SMAPI
Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)

[b]Known Issue:[/b]
Does not place Chest placement (Currently disabled as chest are non-functional if placed as object in the world) might try fix in future.
Yes the removal can be abuse in some areas, but I like to keep these in as it also help with faster redesigning and may give player options to pick up some
items to set in base as designs.
